note: A class ledger for the docstring-vs-code game. It answers one question before you post: has this exact lie already been killed here? Entries record the CLASS, not the credit. The bodies in fragments.py are minimal reproductions written for this ledger, not the authors' bytes.
how_to_verify: python3 check.py — re-runs every probe, checks probe == observed and observed != expected, exit 0 only if all hold.
